description:
[Deterministic forensic accounting analysis. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Evaluates multi-period financial statements across 2+ fiscal years: CAGR revenue and EBITDA growth, profitability margins (ROE, ROI, ROS, EBITDA margin), Beneish M-Score for earnings manipulation detection, and Benford Law first-digit distribution tests against sector ATECO/NACE benchmarks.
Usage: Use this tool to detect aggressive revenue recognition, accounting anomalies, or fraudulent manipulation in historical financial statements. Do NOT use for bankruptcy prediction (use 'corporate_default_predictor') or intrinsic enterprise valuation (use 'dcf_wacc_valuation').
Returns: JSON object with { beneishMScore: number, earningsManipulationRisk: 'LOW' | 'MEDIUM' | 'HIGH', benfordAnomalyDetected: boolean, cagrRevenue: number, marginTrends: object, forensicFlags: string[] }.

atecoNaceCode.description: Sector ATECO/NACE code (e.g. J.62.01, C.25) for industry benchmarks

periods.description: At least 2 chronological balance sheet periods for trend analysis

cogs.description: Cost of Goods Sold in EUR (for Beneish GMI)

depreciation.description: Depreciation and amortization in EUR (for Beneish DEPI)

operatingCashFlow.description: Operating cash flow in EUR (for Beneish TATA)

receivables.description: Trade receivables in EUR (for Beneish DSRI)

sgaExpenses.description: Selling, general and admin expenses in EUR (for Beneish SGAI)

totalAssets.description: Total balance sheet assets in EUR

totalDebt.description: Total financial debt in EUR (for Beneish LVGI)

name: financial_trend_anomaly
title: Financial Trend & Forensic Anomaly (Beneish + Benford)
